sections.title: AI Services for New York Healthcare Organizations
sections.description: HIPAA-compliant AI built specifically for New York's world-class healthcare ecosystem.

items.title: Patient Risk Stratification
items.description: ML models predicting 30-day readmission probability, clinical deterioration risk, ED utilization propensity, and chronic disease onset for proactive care management — trained on your patient population and EHR data, not generic clinical benchmarks. Gradient boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM) and deep learning models validated against your specific patient outcomes. Typical cost: $50,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 14–22 weeks | EHR integration: Epic, Cerner, Meditech standard.
items.label: Patient risk

items.title: Clinical Documentation NLP
items.description: AI reducing physician documentation burden — ambient documentation from visit audio, structured note generation from clinical narrative, ICD-10/CPT coding assistance, and prior authorization document processing. Proven to save 1–2 hours per physician per day in production deployments. Typical cost: $55,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 14–24 weeks | HIPAA-compliant audio handling standard.
items.label: Clinical documentation

items.title: Revenue Cycle Optimization
items.description: ML systems predicting claim denial probability before submission, identifying documentation gaps that cause denials, automating claim scrubbing, and prioritizing AR follow-up by recovery probability. New York's complex payer mix (Medicaid, commercial, managed care) requires models trained on your specific payer relationships. Typical cost: $45,000–$110,000 | Timeline: 12–20 weeks.
items.label: Revenue cycle

items.title: Healthcare Operations AI
items.description: Staffing and scheduling optimization based on predicted patient census by unit, supply chain demand forecasting for medical consumables, patient flow simulation, and discharge planning acceleration. Particularly relevant for New York's large health systems managing complex multi-facility operations. Typical cost: $50,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks.
items.label: Operations AI

items.title: Digital Health and MedTech AI
items.description: For New York's digital health startup ecosystem — building AI capabilities for patient engagement platforms, remote monitoring applications, clinical trial recruitment, and consumer health products. FDA Software as a Medical Device awareness standard for clinical-facing applications. Typical cost: $40,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 12–28 weeks.

sections.title: New York Healthcare Regulatory Compliance Built In
sections.description: ClickMasters builds healthcare AI with full awareness of New York's regulatory framework.

items.title: HIPAA
items.description: Business Associate Agreement in place before any PHI is accessed. Technical safeguards — data encryption at rest and in transit, minimum necessary data use, audit logging of PHI access — are standard components of every ClickMasters healthcare AI engagement. PHI-containing training datasets are handled within HIPAA-compliant infrastructure.
items.label: HIPAA

items.title: New York State DOH
items.description: New York's Department of Health regulations on electronic health records, data sharing, and health information exchange affect AI systems that integrate with New York hospital information systems. ClickMasters designs with New York State-specific health data requirements in mind.
items.label: NY DOH

items.title: FDA Software as a Medical Device (SaMD)
items.description: AI systems that influence clinical diagnosis or treatment decisions may constitute SaMD under FDA guidance, requiring specific validation and potentially 510(k) clearance. ClickMasters designs with FDA SaMD awareness and strongly recommends qualified regulatory counsel for any AI that could be classified as a medical device.
items.label: FDA SaMD

sections.note: Definitive regulatory compliance determinations require qualified healthcare legal and regulatory counsel. ClickMasters provides the technical implementation and documentation; legal interpretation is the domain of qualified counsel.

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.description: Common questions from New York healthcare organizations about AI development with ClickMasters.

items.question: Does ClickMasters sign a Business Associate Agreement for all healthcare AI work?
items.answer: Yes — BAA is executed before any PHI is accessed or processed in any ClickMasters healthcare AI engagement.

items.question: Can ClickMasters build AI that integrates with our Epic or Cerner EHR system?
items.answer: Yes — Epic FHIR API, Epic App Orchard integrations, and Cerner SMART on FHIR applications are standard for New York health system AI projects.

items.question: How does ClickMasters handle de-identification of training data?
items.answer: Through Safe Harbor or Expert Determination de-identification methods appropriate to your specific dataset — ClickMasters builds de-identification pipelines and documents the methodology for compliance review.

items.question: Can AI meaningfully reduce 30-day readmissions for our patient population?
items.answer: ML readmission risk models identifying high-risk patients for proactive intervention consistently demonstrate 10–25% reduction in preventable readmissions in published healthcare AI literature. ClickMasters validates expected performance on your specific patient population during Discovery.

items.question: How long does healthcare AI development take in New York?
items.answer: 12–28 weeks depending on application complexity and EHR integration requirements.

items.question: Does ClickMasters have experience with New York's specific Medicaid managed care AI applications?
items.answer: Yes — New York's Medicaid managed care structure (DSRIP, value-based payment arrangements) creates specific use cases for member risk stratification and care management AI that ClickMasters has designed for.
